You are fixing one small item in the Callisto repo (Rust workspace, your cwd is an isolated git worktree off origin/main; Callisto is 0.21.x, depends on `michi-graph = "0.9"`). Read AGENTS.md and ARCHITECTURE.md briefly first. Be lean: smallest complete change, no new error codes or config keys, comments one short line only when the WHY is non-obvious, no history words in comments.

TASK: `crates/callisto-graph/src/commands/release_simulator.rs` around lines 953-964 has a `#[cfg(test)]` helper `dependents_of` that hand-rolls a transitive closure. michi-graph has `Dag::descendants`; Callisto already builds an `operation_dag`. Read michi-graph 0.9's source (`ls ~/.cargo/registry/src/*/ | grep michi-graph`, then src) and CONFIRM `Dag::descendants` semantics: does it include or exclude the start nodes, does it handle multiple roots, and does the edge direction match `dependents_of`'s meaning. If it is an exact drop-in (or the difference is one trivial adjustment), replace the helper with it and delete the old code. If the semantics do not match, STOP and report why; make no change. No changeset (test-only refactor).

CHECKS (judge by exit code only, never by grepping output; one cargo invocation at a time): `cargo test -p callisto-graph` (rerun once if you see an exit 101 you cannot reproduce, and report it), `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings`, `cargo fmt --check`, `sh testing/check-comments.sh`. Prove the replacement is real, not vacuous: temporarily make the helper return the wrong set and confirm a test fails, then restore.

SHIP (plain separate git commands, no compound or looped git, no `git -C`; Bash with dangerouslyDisableSandbox true for git commit/push/entire/gh): branch `refactor/simulator-uses-dag-descendants`; commit signed (`git commit -S`; never override signing; conventional message, no session links, no AI attribution lines); `git push -u origin <branch>`; then `entire trail link 430 --project gh/orin-dx --repo gh/orin-dx/callisto --branch <branch> --base main`; then `entire trail ci-pr 430 --project gh/orin-dx --repo gh/orin-dx/callisto --branch <branch> --json` (never `gh pr create`). Do NOT approve or merge. Do not touch files outside this task.

Report in under 120 words: the semantics you confirmed, what you changed, check exit codes, PR number, anything you chose not to do.
